findings.evidence: No candidates branch bypasses coverage; AC-001 requires accepted empty snapshot.

findings.summary: A task start with no timestamp is silently discarded
findings.evidence: Ledger start missing ts is ignored; AC-005 requires missing first-start evidence to stay provisional.

findings.summary: Outcome can remain passed while sources are incomplete
findings.evidence: Passed is derived before source.bad/conflicts; status may say passed and source_incomplete.

findings.summary: Migration leaves visible Trial section stale
findings.evidence: Publication retains legacy body after typed cohort update; visible Enrolled: 0/3 can remain.

findings.summary: Malformed trial metadata crashes public status command
findings.evidence: Unvalidated trial[activation] raises KeyError for trial: {schema_version: 1}.

findings.summary: Malformed decision kind bypasses invalid-input response
findings.evidence: kind: [] causes TypeError at set membership before structured rejection.

findings.summary: Commit recheck omits newly registered worktrees
findings.evidence: Reconcile reuses pre-lock roots before publication; git worktree add can introduce earlier start.

findings.summary: Failed stash lookup is treated as no pending stash
findings.evidence: _pending_trial_stash returns False on git stash list OSError; protected stash may remain.

findings.summary: Writer-kill recovery test accepts failed follow-up write
findings.evidence: Test checks reason != lock_busy, allowing revision_conflict or unsupported_lock without write.

findings.summary: Outcome tests omit failure precedence after later evidence
findings.evidence: No test combines confirmed fail with later evidence update; AC-006 requires fail to persist.
